primer-condicional.instruction: Elegí el conector correcto para completar la oración.
primer-condicional.prompt: You can rent the apartment ___ you pay the deposit before Friday.
primer-condicional.explanation: "As long as" expresa la condición necesaria (pagar el depósito) para que algo sea posible (alquilar el departamento).
optionNotes: "Until" indica un límite temporal, no una condición necesaria.
Correcto: pone la condición necesaria para poder alquilar el departamento.
"Unless" significa "a menos que"; invertiría el sentido sugiriendo que puede alquilar solo si NO paga.
"In case" es una precaución, no expresa la condición necesaria para el alquiler.

primer-condicional.instruction: Elegí el conector correcto para completar la oración.
primer-condicional.prompt: I'll send you my resume ___ you need more information about my experience.

"When" sugiere certeza sobre el momento, pero la oración habla de una posibilidad.
"Unless" cambiaría el sentido a "a menos que necesites", lo cual no tiene lógica aquí.
"As long as" expresa una condición necesaria, no una simple precaución.

"Unless" invertiría el sentido, sugiriendo lo opuesto a lo que se quiere decir.

Martín has worked at a marketing agency in Buenos Aires for three years, but lately he feels unhappy. Yesterday he talked to his friend Sofía about an idea: quitting his job and traveling around South America for six months.

Sofía listened carefully. 'If I were you, I wouldn't quit without a plan,' she said. 'If you save money for a few months, you'll have more time to decide.' Martín explained that he already has some savings, but not enough for six months without working.

'If I had more savings, I'd leave next month,' he admitted. 'But if I don't save enough, I'll have to postpone the trip.'

Sofía also mentioned a friend, Lucas, who travels and works online. 'If you learned how to work remotely, you could travel and still earn money,' she suggested. 'If I were you, I'd talk to Lucas before deciding anything.'

Martín thought about it. He knows that if he talks to Lucas this week, he'll get useful information. But if he quits now, he'll lose his monthly salary and his savings won't last long.

foro-consejos.text:
Sofi92: Hi everyone, I need some advice. I work in marketing for a company in Palermo, and for the last few months, my coworker Lucas has been presenting my ideas as his own in meetings. Yesterday he took credit for a campaign I designed, and our boss praised him in front of everyone. I feel really frustrated, but I don't want to cause a conflict at work. What should I do?

AdviceGuru: I'm sorry to hear you're going through this, Sofi. It's a tricky situation, but here's what I think. If I were you, I'd talk to Lucas directly before going to your boss. If he realizes you're upset, he might stop doing it. However, if he doesn't change his behavior after that conversation, I think you should mention it to your manager, with proof of your work. Keep copies of your emails and drafts in case you need them later. Unless Lucas apologizes and gives you credit next time, I wouldn't trust him with your ideas again. As long as you stay calm and professional, this won't damage your reputation at work.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué recomienda AdviceGuru que haga Sofi primero, según 'If I were you, I'd talk to Lucas directly before going to your boss'?
options: Esperar a que Lucas se disculpe solo
Hablar con Lucas antes de ir a la jefa
questions.explanation: 'If I were you, I'd + verbo' es el segundo condicional para dar consejos hipotéticos; acá indica que lo primero que recomienda es hablar con Lucas antes de ir a la jefa.

questions.prompt: Según el texto, ¿cuándo cree AdviceGuru que Sofi debería hablar con su jefa?
options: Lo antes posible, sin hablar antes con Lucas
Solo si Lucas se disculpa primero
Solo si Lucas no cambia su comportamiento después de hablar con él
Solo si la jefa nota el problema sola
questions.explanation: La oración 'if he doesn't change his behavior... I think you should mention it to your manager' usa el primer condicional para mostrar una consecuencia real si Lucas no cambia.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué significa 'Unless Lucas apologizes and gives you credit next time, I wouldn't trust him with your ideas again'?
options: Si Lucas se disculpa, AdviceGuru igual no confiará en él
Lucas ya se disculpó, así que todo está resuelto
AdviceGuru siempre confiará en Lucas sin importar qué pase
Si Lucas no se disculpa ni da crédito, AdviceGuru no confiaría en él otra vez
questions.explanation: 'Unless' equivale a 'if... not', entonces la oración significa que si Lucas no se disculpa ni da crédito, no se puede confiar en él otra vez.

foro-consejos.text:
Renter22: Hi all, I moved out of my apartment in Rosario last month, and my landlord, Marcos, still hasn't returned my deposit. He says he needs to check for damages, but I left the place in perfect condition. I have photos from move-in and move-out day. I'm getting worried because I need that money for my new place. Any advice?

AdviceGuru: I know how stressful this must be. If I were you, I'd send Marcos a formal email with the photos attached, asking for a clear explanation. If he ignores your message, you'll have grounds to report him to a tenants' association. I think you should also check your rental contract in case it mentions a deadline for returning deposits. Unless Marcos replies within a week, I'd consider that a bad sign. As long as you have proof of the apartment's condition, you're in a strong position. Try not to call him too often, though, because that could seem aggressive. If you stay polite but firm, he'll probably respond faster than you expect.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué sugiere AdviceGuru que le envíe Renter22 a Marcos?
options: Un mensaje de texto pidiendo plata
Un email formal con fotos adjuntas
Nada, solo esperar a que Marcos la contacte
Una carta de un abogado de inmediato
questions.explanation: El consejo 'If I were you, I'd send Marcos a formal email with the photos attached' usa el segundo condicional para recomendar una acción concreta.

questions.prompt: Según AdviceGuru, ¿qué debería pensar Renter22 si Marcos no responde en una semana?
options: Que el depósito está perdido para siempre
Que debería dejar de revisar sus mails
questions.explanation: 'Unless Marcos replies within a week' significa 'si Marcos no responde', y la consecuencia que propone AdviceGuru es considerarlo una mala señal.

questions.prompt: ¿Por qué recomienda AdviceGuru revisar el contrato de alquiler?
options: Porque el contrato probará que Marcos está mintiendo
Porque los contratos en Rosario siempre son distintos
Por si menciona un plazo para devolver el depósito
questions.explanation: 'In case' se usa para tomar una precaución ante algo que podría pasar, en este caso que el contrato tenga un plazo para devolver el depósito.
